Class DispatcherJMVAschema

java.lang.Object
jmva.engine.DispatcherJMVAschema
public class DispatcherJMVAschema extends Object

Name: DispatcherJMVAschema

Description: Receives the absolute path of a xml file which describes the model using the JMTmodel.xsd schema. This file is converted into another xml file in order to be passed to the simulator. The simulation results, at the end, are converted and are inserted in the original file.

Date: 13-lug-2006 Time: 11.15.47

Version:
2.0
Author:
Stefano Omini, Bertoli Marco

    • removeNullMeasures

      protected void removeNullMeasures(ExactModel input, CommonModel output)
      Removes all null measures from output model. A null measure is a measure from a class with 0 service demand at a station. Removed measures are stored to be later restored.
      Parameters:
      input - input JMVA model
      output - output JSIM model
